operators.name: flip_forward
semantics: Performs torch.flip(x, [dim]) exactly: reverses the order of elements along the specified dimension.
For this task, dim is expected to be 2 (as provided in init_inputs (2,)).
No broadcasting or dtype changes; output has same shape, dtype, and device as input.
The input tensor must be on CUDA; output is allocated on same device.
If multiple dims are needed, separate operator or different interface would be required, but for this task single dim is sufficient.
torch.flip(x, dims) reverses order along each dimension in dims.
In this task, self.flip_dims is (2,), so only dimension 2 is flipped.
If input is on CUDA, output is on CUDA; no dtype conversion.
